requirements_summary: Workload: interactive chat/agent for product-support + in-app automation (tool calling to ticketing and CRM)
Latency SLOs: target p95 first-token <= 700ms for short-turn responses; end-to-end 95th pct <= 1.5s for standard replies (20-80 tokens)
Throughput: ~200 concurrent active users, burst to 500, average 4-6 requests/user/day during peak campaign
Streaming: must support server-side streaming to front-end (low startup latency) and incremental tool-call hooks
Tool calling: require robust function calling, deterministic fallback if external tool latencies spike
Quality gating: prompt / eval regression gating required — need A/B and canary rollout support with automatic quality regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated if it reduces tail latency and predictable unit cost
Model preferences: open models with quantized variants acceptable; want Redwood recommendations on quantization vs quality tradeoffs
Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs for tool calls, KMS integration for keys, data residency for EU customers
poc_plan: Week 0: Provide hosted API keys + sample dataset (30k tokens) — Redwood to run baseline perf tests
Week 1: Integrate streaming client + tool-calling hooks; measure p50/p95 first-token and end-to-end
Week 2: Run prompt/eval suite (500 prompts) to establish quality baseline; implement automated eval pipelines and alerting
Week 3: A/B test two prompt+model variants (latency-optimized vs quality-optimized); run canary rollout on 10% traffic and monitor regression metrics
Success criteria: hosted API meets p95 first-token <=700ms for 80% of traffic and no significant quality regression (>2% metric drop) during A/B; otherwise schedule Dedicated pilot
notes: AE notes: very product-led engineering team, fast decision cycles but strict SLO ownership
SE notes: front-end requires chunked streaming; prefer websocket for UX. Concern about tool-call orchestration adding tail latency — want automatic fallbacks and circuit breakers.
Legal: asks for data processing addendum for EU customers, retention controls and auditability
Finance: leaning toward committed capacity if Redwood can demonstrate predictability on unit cost and 20-30% cost reduction vs current self-hosting estimate
